finding: Direct answer = single LLM call, no expert dispatch
coding-expert wraps 3+ MCP tools; LLM autonomously chains them; data-json carries structured payload
pubmed-expert returns web_result[] items (PMID URLs); single search tool
Dual expert dispatch is SEQUENTIAL not parallel; LLM emits two function calls one at a time
Corti Orchestrator = single LLM with function calling, NOT Planner->Delegator->Aggregator pipeline. LLM is de-facto Planner+Delegator+Aggregator.
implication: iCoDer existing 15-module orchestrator is over-engineered for Corti-parity single-agent runs. Use lightweight CortiLikeOrchestrator for single-agent; reserve existing orchestrator for Gate 4 7-stage mainline.

finding: Corti Expert = collection of MCP tools. Type 'reference' = Corti-hosted. Type 'mcp' = bring-your-own MCP server. Expert invocation event = data-status-update(message='Calling expert: <name>').
implication: iCoDer ToolMCPCompatLayer (Phase 4-A) already implements this pattern. Gate 3 wraps it as 'Experts' for Corti-parity.

finding: Vercel AI SDK UI Message Stream v1 (x-vercel-ai-ui-message-stream: v1 header). Event types: data-status-update, text-start, text-delta, text-end, data-json, message-metadata, finish, [DONE].
implication: iCoDer Gate 6 SSE event projector must emit same protocol for Corti-parity. Existing iCoDer trace_events is similar but custom; consider dual-protocol support.

finding: Corti has NO first-class context field in chat request. Context = system_prompt (static) + message_history + file_attachments. messageMetadata returns server-generated contextId+taskId.
implication: iCoDer Context spec (patient_id+encounter_id+tenant_id+source_system+api_client_id+idempotency_key+PHI redaction) is strictly richer. This is iCoDer differentiator for hospital integration.

finding: Corti has NO explicit Aggregator. LLM synthesizes multiple tool calls into final text-delta. No aggregation.started/completed events.
implication: iCoDer Aggregator module only needed for Gate 4 7-stage mainline (cross-agent merge). For single-agent Corti-parity, LLM suffices.

finding: Credits consumed: Exp A (no expert) = $0.028388; Exp B (1 expert 3 tools) = $0.058968 (2.08x). Expert invocation roughly doubles cost.
implication: iCoDer Usage tracking must itemize per-expert cost. Existing run_history.cost field already supports this; Gate 6 should add per-expert breakdown.

finding: Corti SDK pattern: cortiClient.agents.create({name,experts[{name,type:'reference'}],description,systemPrompt}) + cortiClient.agents.messageSend(agentId,{message:{role,parts:[{text,kind:'text'}],messageId,kind:'message'}}). A2A v0.3 message envelope.
implication: iCoDer A2A spec (memory E--Corti4C-docs-ICODER_V1_A2A_SPEC.md) aligns. message.parts[].kind='text' is the field name (not 'type'). iCoDer Gate 6 should verify field name alignment.

finding: coding-expert data-json payload schema: search_codes returns {code_system, count, query, results[{code,description,match_path,related_codes{category,category_description,count}}], next_steps[{reason,tool}]}. verify returns {assignable,code,description,parent,related_codes[],total_related,next_steps[]}. explore returns {assignable,code,description,parents[],next_steps[]}.
implication: iCoDer Gate 1 StructuredOutputProjector should mirror these schemas for verify_code/explore_code/get_guidelines MCP tools (already exist). Need new 'search_codes' tool for code-system-wide search.

finding: Corti context = 3 weak layers (system_prompt baked, message_history, file_attachments dropped as JSON). No per-message tenant_id/patient_id/encounter_id.
implication: iCoDer ContextBuilder (Gate 3) provides strict superset. For backend-service hospital integration, iCoDer wins.
